implementation.packet: Separate root-owned packet must bind exact methods/root, actual P1 terminal and hashlock refs, and all five name/version/file/size/hash identities. CLI requires external methods and packet digests. No actual packet was created.
implementation.P1: Consumes v1_2 COMPLETE only, with prefix-relative artifact refs, full wheel hash/size/ZIP/tag/selection replay, both failed ancestor ref sets, both terminal write totals and the full 16 MiB prior failed-wheel charge.
implementation.closure: Bounded Requires-Dist parsing and safe AST markers, without eval. Known CPython 3.12.14/macOS arm64 variables only. Active unknown/unsatisfied dependencies or extras block; inactive markers remain recorded. Exact five installed distributions and metadata closure are checked independently and by ordinary pip check.
implementation.python312: Under -S, sys.prefix may remain the base. Use explicit --prefix plus --ignore-installed; public sysconfig target paths must resolve to the new environment. Load only the hash-bound pip package through public importlib, never add its old site-packages parent to sys.path; invoke ordinary CLI using runpy.
implementation.commands: Exactly three serial direct children: venv without pip, offline install, metadata-only check. Install includes --no-index, exact --find-links wheel directory, --no-deps, --no-compile, --no-cache-dir, --only-binary=:all:, --require-hashes. No --python reexecution, builds, dependency fallback or helpers.
implementation.limits: 120 wall seconds; 7/8 CPU seconds per parent/child; observed self plus reaped CPU cutoff 40. Three direct children imply at most 32 CPU seconds under the kernel/no-descendants assumptions. Live CPU is not sampled; each command reserves an 8-second unresolved upper bound. Child remaining-wall alarms survive parent death subject to blocking-OS overshoot.
implementation.IO: 256 KiB captured command output, 768 MiB polled logical owned tree, per-guest Python write precharges, 64 MiB file-size cap, bounded read refs, 8 MiB controls with 32 KiB terminal headroom. These are trusted-code guards, not a physical filesystem quota, RSS limit or exhaustive OS I/O meter.
implementation.guard: All socket/fork/subprocess/ctypes activity and downloaded pypdf/PIL/cryptography/cffi/_cffi_backend/pycparser imports are denied in guests. Writes are restricted to the new environment/stage; reviewed directory-FD cleanup handling is reused.
implementation.journal: Create-once scope and target, durable STARTED, requirements, closure, payloads, reservations, command results/logs and terminal. Failures preserve partial environments and cannot replay. Full original pip/base bootstrap is rehashed after commands.
